##A
1. 
```{r}
v<- c(seq(5, 50, by=5))
v

length(v)
sum(v)
mean(v)
```

2. 
```{r}
w <- c(1, 2, 3)
rep (w, times=4) 
z<- c(1, 2, 3)
rep (z, each=4)

```

3.
```{r}
A <- 17
B <- 5
C <- 2
D <- 10
E <- 144

result1 <- A %% B
result1

result2 <- A/B
result2

result3 <- D^C
result3

result4 <- sqrt(E)
result4

result5 <- round(pi, digits=3)
result5
```

4. 
```{r}
a <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
b <- c(1, 3, 5, 7)

resulta <- a+b
resulta

resultb <- a*b
resultb

resultc <- a>b
resultc

resultd <- sum(a*b)
resultd
```

5. 
```{r}
paste ("Student-1", "Student-2", "Student-3")

mode(42)

mode("42")
mode (41i)
mode (TRUE)
```


##B

1. 
```{r}

  id <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)
  name <- c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro")
  sex <- c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M")
  section <- c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B")
  midterm <- c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59)
  final <- c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65)
  attendance <- c (95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60)
  
students <- data.frame(id = id, name = name, sex = sex, section=section, midterm =midterm, final=final, attendance=attendance)
print(students)
  

```

2. 
```{r}
str(students)

dim(students)

names(students)

summary(students)

```

3. 
```{r}
colMeans(students[, c("midterm", "final")])

students$average <- (students$midterm + students$final) / 2

students$remarks <- ifelse(students$average >= 70 & students$attendance >=75 , "Passed", "Failed")

students[students$remarks == "Failed", c("name", "average")]
```
